meta.summary: Hides "open the app" prompts, sign-in pop-up, "join LinkedIn" banners, promoted posts and ads, Premium prompts, suggestions
meta.notes: METHOD: the automation browser failed to start in this session (isolated JS worker module not found, Python bridge refused to start), so nothing was rendered or scrolled. Every selector comes from the server-rendered HTML that www.linkedin.com returned over plain HTTP (curl, iPhone UA, logged out, 2026-11-08, status 200) for /, /jobs/, /in/williamhgates, a /pulse/ article, /jobs/view/<id>, /jobs/search/?keywords=engineer, /company/microsoft. Counts below are element counts in that HTML ('HTML'), not in a live DOM; none is LIVE in the rendered-page sense. HTML: LinkedIn's public pages use stable BEM class names and data attributes, no hashed classes. .promo-bottom-sheet: 1 on /jobs/ (class hidden until script shows it; text 'LinkedIn is better on the app', Open App / Browser Continue). Not in the HTML of /, /in, /pulse, /company. .contextual-sign-in-modal[data-show-on-page-load]: 1 each on the profile, article, job view, job search and company pages (data-show-delay-ms 0, overlay starts opacity-0 invisible and script opens it); other .contextual-sign-in-modal wrappers (Follow, Connect, Apply, contact info) have no data-show-on-page-load and are left alone. .bottom-cta-banner 1 and .aside-section-container:has(.top-content-cta) 1 on the profile; same top-content card 1 on a job page; .find-a-referral 1 on a job page; [data-id=conversion-prompt] 1 on a company page (hidden by default, shown by script). Suggestions: .browsemap 1 and .related-posts 1 (profile), .articles-content-card 1 and .top-content-categories 1 (article), .people-also-viewed 1, .similar-jobs 1, .similar-searches 1 and [data-test-id=more-searches] 1 (job page), affiliated-pages / similar-pages / browse-jobs 1 each (company). Comments: .comments__container 1 with 5 .comment, .article-social-activity 1 (fixed bottom bar) on the article. Activity: section.activities 1 (profile), section.updates 1 (company). Promo: .explore-top-content, .top-product-categories, .game-hub-banner, section.directory 1 each on /, footer.li-footer 1 on every page. NOT VERIFIED: how the sheet, pop-up and fixed bar look when script opens them; whether the pop-up locks body scroll (no unlock rule shipped); cookie/consent banners (none in the HTML, EU only toasts use a generic #toasts template, deliberately not hidden); the logged-in app is not covered; /pub/dir and some routes answer 999 to curl. Selectors are not compared with a community filter list. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA, logged out, live in the app, 2026-11-10): the home page showed the Google One Tap prompt (google-one-tap matched) and the public rules above still match. INFERRED (the feed needs a sign-in; hand-written fixture desktop-feed.html): feed-aside, messaging-bubble, ad-banners, premium-links.
